scope: 15 saved Natural Scene splits; no retuning joint method

methods.Random k: 20 fixed random k subsets; average test metrics, not best chosen
methods.Correlation k: sum squared feature-label correlations, top k
methods.Forward k: training-inner Brier sequential forward selection to exactly k; no cost ranking
methods.Cost-correlation budget: correlation score/cost, greedy fit within joint cost budget
methods.Cost-forward budget: positive inner Brier decrease/cost, greedy within joint cost budget; stop if no positive gain
methods.Prediction-only: same original guarded heuristic, dependency identically zero; no matched quota
methods.Budget-forward bridge: cost-constrained forward search with nonpositive bridge; best inner-risk prefix incl empty; preserve positive-only baseline

fairness: k and cost budget are joint outputs determined by training only. Same predictor, folds, normalization and costs. Test data already examined in prior diagnostics; exploratory paired comparison, not untouched confirmation. Generic controls and wrapper baselines, no claimed replicas of named published algorithms.
note: Added to address established zero-singleton interaction issue; descriptive extension after early baseline diagnostics, not new untouched evaluation.
